quotes.name: Janae Rivers
quotes.quote: I'm still seeing the same desperation, same grind. But I'm also seeing some real change on the horizon. We've got the Youth Apprenticeship Pipeline launching in East Oakland, and that's a start. It's not just talk this time; we're putting the first rung of the ladder in their hands. The Alternative Response Initiative is changing how we answer calls, too. It's not just about East Oakland anymore; the cracks are spreading, and we need to act before West Oakland and Fruitvale get hit harder.
